moment: Persistent monthly exit of wives, job tenure 0-5 months
definition: 63's SIPP sample: married wives 25-59, employed at t-1 and t, husband employed at t and t+1, all four months observed; exit = not employed (no job in any week) at t+1 and t+2, all reasons incl. involuntary; tenure at t = months since the employer-specific start date (TSJDATE 2004/08; start year/month 2014; first month seen otherwise); unknown tenure dropped; wife's weight; cluster (household) bootstrap s.e. (200 replications, 34,649 clusters). Model: tenure = months since the start of the current employment spell (no job-to-job moves in the model); spells running since entry count as unknown unless 12+ months old.

moment: Back in work within 12 months of a persistent exit (Kaplan-Meier)
definition: 63 table (iv): KM probability of a return to employment within 12 months of the first non-employed month t+1, censored at the end of the couple's observation; 100-replication cluster bootstrap s.e. Model: same KM in the three SIPP windows. Reported only.

moment: Share of couples with an annual exit that have two or more
definition: 63 (v-repeat): annual exit = wife's hours > 0 in t and 0 in t+1, same couple, husband working both years, wife 25-59, annual years (t+1 <= 1996); share of couples with >= 1 exit that have >= 2 (mean 7.1 eligible years per couple); binomial s.e. Model: same rule on income years 1984-1996 (the simulation starts in 1984). Reported only.

moment: Still with the baseline husband, years 1-3 after her displacement (both groups observed at the first interview after ev)
definition: 64's M3 design: wives of male heads with a child 0-17 and positive own hours at baseline, first displaced (closure or layoff/firing; wife's and female head's reports) in ev vs clean controls (not displaced to ev+6); person x stack and year x stack FE; reference e = -2; events 1984-2021, outcome years <= 2021; 65 Section 5b: treated and controls both observed at the first interview >= ev (attrition equalised); pooled races; CR1 s.e. clustered by 1968 family. Mean of e = +1..+3. Target.
